verdict.rationale: Cua documents agent-driven control of native apps through the Driver (MCP/CLI) and programmatic streaming of a Space desktop or single window, which implies screen capture is available to agents. The docs never explicitly describe screenshot or vision input feeding the agent, or how actions are grounded on displayed elements. One hands-on report (an older OMNI-loop setup) had the agent type in the wrong place, which suggests grounding is unreliable but does not contradict a specific claim. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of screenshot/vision capture as agent input, documented visual grounding of actions (element/coordinate mapping), independent corroboration of accurate grounding.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the agent perceives the live screen (capture or vision input) and grounds its actions on what is actually displayed

citations.quote: lets an agent drive native apps on macOS, Windows and Linux in the background, through MCP or a CLI
